# U26: Find what will sink the north star on the goal map, and read its story

- **Belongs to:** the Goal map module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-MAP`
- **Budget:** 8 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `errors`, `budget` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U26

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Step.** Choose the “Map” layout (the Layout menu on a computer; the View sheet on a phone).
- **Check:** The “Goal map” section shows.
- **Check:** A goal on the Goal map shows.
- _Note:_ The critical path runs from the north star through the off-track input, and the map opens on it.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `onPath.includes('ns-lead') && onPath.includes('lead-merge') && onPath.includes('lead-mq') && !onPath.includes('lead-review')`, where `const onPath = await p.locator('.react-flow__node[aria-label*="critical path"]').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-id')))`. Else it says: critical path: {onPath.join(', ')}.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `!!box && !!area && box.x >= area.x - 1 && box.x + box.width <= area.x + area.width + 1`, where `const canvas = p.getByRole('region', { name: /Goal map/ })`; `const access = p.locator('.react-flow__node[data-id="lead-mq"]')`; `const box = await access.boundingBox()`; `const area = await canvas.boundingBox()`. Else it says: the map does not open on the critical path.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “map”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ A goal opens its story beside the map.
- **Step.** Press the react flow node (`.react-flow__node[data-id="lead-mq"]`).
- **Check:** The “Merge queue live for every monorepo” side panel shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/Why/.test(await panel.innerText()) && /On the critical path/.test(await panel.innerText()) && await panel.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open the goal' }).isVisible()`, where `const panel = p.getByRole('complementary', { name: /Merge queue live for every monorepo/ })`. Else it says: the story panel is missing its why or link.
- _Note:_ It opens folded to the top goals with only the critical path beneath them (MAP, 9 Nov); Unfold all shows every goal, Fold to the top goes back; then show only what needs attention.
- **Step.** Press the “Unfold all” button.
- _Note:_ Dotted lines for goals that also help others. The canvas draws its lines after the nodes are measured, so wait for them rather than counting at once. (Drawn, not necessarily on screen: on a phone they sit lower down.)
- **Step.** Press the “Fold to the top” button.
- **Step.** Press the attention switch (`.attention-switch:visible`).
- _Note:_ It's the status filter now, so the map redraws from the link, every match unfolded.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `before < all && folded === before && attention < all && attention >= 3`, where `const before = await p.locator('.react-flow__node').count()`; `const all = await p.locator('.react-flow__node').count()`; `const folded = await p.locator('.react-flow__node').count()`; `const attention = await p.locator('.react-flow__node').count()`. Else it says: nodes: {before} on opening, {all} unfolded, {folded} folded again, {attention} needing attention.
- **Step.** Press the attention switch (`.attention-switch:visible`).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `helps`, where `const helps = await p.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__edge.helps').length > 0, null, { timeout: 5000 }).then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: no dotted also-helps lines.
- Close this browser.

How to read these lines: [the journeys](../../../core/journeys.md#how-to-read-a-journeys-steps).
